title: Planning notes - data
description: What a note, letter or estimate says is still to come in the year: salary, a bonus, interest, sales planned, deductions intended, tax to be deducted. Expectations, not evidence: none of this enters the return. Each is transcribed as stated, with the period it is stated for; the arithmetic is done in code.

as_of.description: The date the note was written or speaks from, YYYY-MM-DD, where it says.

kind.description: salary: regular pay. bonus: a one-off payment from the employer. interest, dividend, other_income: income from other sources. capital_gain: a sale planned or expected, with its gain or loss. deduction: an investment or payment meant for Chapter VI-A (80C, 80D and so on). tds: tax expected to be deducted at source.

description.description: The note's own words for it, e.g. 'Monthly gross after the April revision'.

amount.description: As stated, in rupees, positive. For a capital gain, the size of the gain or loss; say which in direction.

per.description: month: the amount recurs monthly (give from_month and to_month where stated). year: the amount is for the whole financial year. once: a single payment or sale.

from_month.description: First month a monthly amount applies to, YYYY-MM, where stated.

to_month.description: Last month a monthly amount applies to, YYYY-MM, where stated.

on.description: The date a one-off payment or a sale is expected, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM, where stated.

direction.description: For a capital gain: whether the amount is a gain or a loss.

asset_class.description: For a capital gain: what is being sold. equity_stt is shares listed in India and equity funds; foreign_shares is shares listed abroad, such as RSUs of a US employer.

acquired_on.description: For a capital gain: when what is sold was bought or vested, YYYY-MM-DD, where stated. The holding period, and so the rate, is worked out from it in code.

term.description: For a capital gain: short- or long-term, only where the note itself says so. Leave null when it does not.

section.description: For a deduction: the section of Chapter VI-A it is meant for, where the note says or it is unambiguous (PPF and ELSS are 80C; health insurance is 80D).
